slides.0.subtitle: Geography, grapes and the pyramid
slides.1.title: Level 1 review
slides.1.highlights.0.title: Geography and history
slides.1.highlights.0.content: Vienne to Avignon; the south gives most output; papacy to Avignon (1309); Baron Le Roy and the AOC forerunner
slides.1.highlights.1.title: Climate and soils
slides.1.highlights.1.content: North: semi-continental, granite, steep slopes; south: Mediterranean, galets and sedimentary soils; the Mistral is shared
slides.1.highlights.2.title: Grapes
slides.1.highlights.2.content: Red: Syrah (north), Grenache (the largest, in the south), Mourvèdre, Cinsault, Carignan; white: Viognier, Marsanne, Roussanne, Grenache Blanc, Clairette
slides.1.highlights.3.title: The pyramid
slides.1.highlights.3.content: Côtes du Rhône → Villages → Villages + name → 18 crus (8 north + 10 south)
slides.1.content: After the assessment, move on to Level 2: appellation-by-appellation depth and regulations.
slides.2.componentProps.slide.title: 📋 Level 1 Final Assessment
Which best describes the north–south split of Rhône output?
A. The north produces the great majority
B. The south produces the great majority
The south dominates volume; the north is small and refined.
What is the core red grape of the northern Rhône?
Syrah leads the reds of the northern crus.
Which red grape has the largest plantings in the Rhône Valley?
Grenache far exceeds every other red.
What is the Mistral's main positive effect on Rhône vineyards?
B. Drying vines and reducing disease
The dry, strong wind keeps fruit healthy but can damage shoots.
Which grape do Condrieu and Château-Grillet use?
How many crus does the Rhône now have?
8 north + 10 south = 18; 21 is the number of Villages that may add a name — do not confuse them.
Which cru is the Rhône's only one devoted to rosé?
Tavel makes only rosé; Lirac also makes red and white.
In a GSM blend, what is Grenache's main role?
A. Providing fruit, roundness and alcohol
B. Providing deep colour and heavy tannin
Grenache brings fruit and alcohol; Syrah adds colour and tannin, Mourvèdre structure.
